faq.q: What makes a good green frog name?
faq.a: A good green frog name should match your pet's personality, be easy to pronounce and remember, and ideally be one or two syllables.

faq.q: Should I choose a name based on appearance?
faq.a: Absolutely! Distinctive features make wonderful naming inspiration.

faq.q: Can I use a human name?
faq.a: Human names are very popular for pets and can make the bond feel more personal.

faq.q: How many names should I consider?
faq.a: Shortlist 3-5 favorites and test them over a few days.

faq.q: Do green frogs respond to certain sounds?
faq.a: Animals respond best to names ending in vowel sounds, especially 'ee' sounds.

faq.q: How do I find a unique name for my Green Frog?
faq.a: Unique names often come from less obvious sources: scientific names (e.g., Panthera), foreign languages, obscure mythology, musical terms, or personal memories. Observe your Green Frog's quirks — a distinctive behavior or marking can inspire a one-of-a-kind name nobody else will have.

faq.q: Should my Green Frog's name reflect their species?
faq.a: It can, but it doesn't have to. Some owners love species-referential names (''Stripes'' for a zebra, ''Fin'' for a fish), while others prefer names that contrast playfully (''Tiny'' for a large animal). Let your Green Frog's individual personality guide you more than their species label.
